purpose: Post-hoc engineering revision of the causal adaptive threshold controller after V1 met the FPR cap but missed the sole positive onset.
selection_context: The 2017 score period and V1 aggregate result are already inspected. V2 is explicitly tuned development work and is not held-out evidence.
claim_boundary: Any V2 result is retrospective post-hoc engineering only. It must not be described as independent validation, state of the art, operational readiness, prospective validation, or evidence from an untouched holdout.

controller.rationale: V1's 0.85 quantile was too conservative. V2 freezes a simpler 0.80 quantile, corresponding to a 20% internal negative exceedance target and 10 percentage points of headroom below the requested 30% FPR cap.

success_gate.interpretation_if_passed: better retrospective operating point only; still requires genuinely uninspected or prospective validation
